name: New Candel - Bar Detector
summary: This EA is a new bar detection utility that monitors M1 bar closing times and plays a sound alert when a new bar is about to close. It uses a flag-based mechanism to prevent multiple alerts per bar and provides on-chart commentary showing bar timing information.
summary_zh: 这是一个新K线检测工具EA，通过监控M1周期K线收盘时间，在新K线即将收盘时播放声音提醒。它使用标志位机制防止每个K线多次触发，并在图表上显示K线时间信息的注释。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是检测M1周期新K线的形成时刻，通过比较当前服务器时间与上一根K线的预计收盘时间来判断新K线是否到来。入场条件方面，当当前时间恰好等于预计收盘时间且标志位为false时，触发新K线通知并播放声音。出场条件不适用于此工具，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理均不存在，该EA纯粹是一个时间检测和通知工具。该EA的核心逻辑依赖于TimeCurrent()与计算得出的收盘时间精确匹配，这在实际交易环境中由于tick到达的不确定性可能导致错过检测窗口。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is to detect the formation of new M1 bars by comparing the current server time with the calculated closing time of the previous bar. The entry condition triggers when the current time exactly equals the calculated bar close time and the flag is false, playing a sound alert and setting the flag. Exit conditions are not applicable since this is a non-trading utility. Position sizing and money management are completely absent, as the EA does not execute any trades. The core logic relies on an exact time match between TimeCurrent() and the calculated close time, which is fragile because tick arrivals are irregular and the exact-second match may be missed. The flag reset mechanism correctly resets when the current time exceeds the close time, preparing for the next bar cycle.

parameters.name: NewBarRecived
parameters.description: 新K线标志位，控制是否已接收新K线通知
parameters.description_en: New bar flag indicating whether a new bar notification was received

pros: 逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和使用
使用标志位防止同一K线多次触发，设计合理
提供图表注释显示时间信息，便于调试和验证
声音提醒功能实用，能及时通知交易者新K线到来
代码结构规范，遵循MQL5 EA模板格式
pros_en: Simple and clear logic, easy to understand and use
Flag-based mechanism prevents multiple triggers per bar, well designed
On-chart commentary displays timing information for debugging and verification
Sound alert feature is practical for notifying traders of new bar arrivals
Code structure follows standard MQL5 EA template conventions
cons: 依赖TimeCurrent()与收盘时间的精确秒级匹配，在tick稀疏时可能完全错过检测窗口
硬编码PERIOD_M1周期，无法灵活配置其他时间框架
全局变量NewBarRecived在EA重启后重置，可能导致重复触发或遗漏
没有使用MQL5标准的新K线检测方法（如比较iTime偏移量），方法不够健壮
拼写错误较多（Recived应为Received，Falgs应为Flags），反映代码质量欠佳
cons_en: Relies on exact second-level time match which can be completely missed during sparse tick periods
Hardcoded PERIOD_M1 timeframe with no flexibility to configure other periods
Global variable NewBarRecived resets on EA restart, potentially causing duplicate triggers or missed bars
Does not use the standard MQL5 new bar detection method (comparing iTime shifts), making it less robust
Multiple spelling errors (Recived vs Received, Falgs vs Flags) reflect poor code quality
improvements: 改用标准的新K线检测方法：记录上一根K线的开盘时间，当iTime(_Symbol,PERIOD,0)变化时判定新K线到来，避免依赖精确时间匹配
将时间框架和声音文件路径设为可配置输入参数，增加灵活性和可复用性
improvements_en: Adopt the standard new bar detection method: store the previous bar's open time and detect new bars when iTime(_Symbol,PERIOD,0) changes, avoiding reliance on exact time matching
Make the timeframe and sound file path configurable input parameters for greater flexibility and reusability

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无财务风险
时间匹配逻辑不可靠可能导致通知遗漏，但不会造成资金损失
risk_points_en: The EA does not execute any trading operations, no financial risk
Unreliable time matching logic may cause missed notifications but will not cause financial loss
